name: boundsvg-monorepo
description: Declarative JSX layout components for reproducible SVG/PNG/WebP/GIF generation with WASM-based font shaping and rasterization
author: zakideee

scripts.build:wasm:mp4: cd crates/boundmp4 && RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}=/cargo --remap-path-prefix=${RUSTUP_HOME:-$HOME/.rustup}=/rustup --remap-path-prefix=$PWD=/build" wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../../packages/video/wasm-pkg && rm -f ../../packages/video/wasm-pkg/.gitignore
scripts.test:coverage:ts: pnpm --filter @boundsvg/core test:coverage && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/react test:coverage && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/cli test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage:rust: cd crates/boundsvg && (cargo llvm-cov --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'cargo-llvm-cov is required. Run: rustup component add llvm-tools-preview && cargo install cargo-llvm-cov' && exit 1)) && cargo llvm-cov --workspace --lcov --output-path target/llvm-cov/lcov.info
scripts.test:e2e:prepare: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:wasm:web && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/shape build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/core build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/browser build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/worker build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/react build && pnpm build:wasm:mp4 && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/video build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/playground-react build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/playground-core build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @boundsvg/shape build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/core build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/browser build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/worker build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/video build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/react build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/cli build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/extras build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/testing build && pnpm --filter @boundsvg/bench typecheck && pnpm check:public-declarations && tsc --build --noEmit tsconfig.check.json && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.type-tests.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.type-tests.json --noEmit
scripts.lint:rust: cd crates/boundsvg && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.version: pnpm check:release-version-transition && changeset version && bash scripts/sync-cargo-version.sh && pnpm check:release-version-sync && pnpm check:release-version-transition
